title: tc-extraction-review
description:
Fields extracted from a document, each linked to its box on the page: confidence per field, accept, correct or
reject, field by field from the keyboard while the page view follows.

fields.description: The reviewed fields – the value. Each review replaces the list (tc-fields-change)

pages.description: The document's pages, in order: an image URL and its size in pixels per page

source.description: The document the fields came from, e.g. "invoice-2041.pdf" – shown under the heading and in page alt texts

threshold.description: Confidence below this (0–1) marks a field "Low" so people check it first

confirmLabel.description: The label of the button that hands the reviewed fields back

value.description: The value – the extracted one, or the correction once corrected

confidence.description: How sure the extraction is, 0 to 1

box.description: Where the value was found; a field without one has nothing to highlight

original.description: The extracted value, kept when a person corrects it

ExtractionBox.description: Where a field sits on a page, in that page's pixels

src.description: The page image's URL – a data: URL works too

alt.description: What the page is, for people who can't see it – "Page 1 of invoice.pdf" by default

ExtractionPage.description: One page of the document: an image and its size in pixels (the space the boxes are in)
